nodes.description: Initializes ballot DB; reads block.timestamp to clamp startTs and enforce endTs > now, stores packed bits, specHash and creationTs.
Internal vote recorder; requires ballot open, writes votes[nVotesCast], packs now<<160 with sender, increments nVotesCast.
External ETH-ballot submission; calls _addVote with msg.sender and sets sequenceNumber[msg.sender] = MAX_UINT32.
Verifies an EIP-191 style signature via ecrecover over proxyReq and delegates the recovered voter to _addVote.
Authorization check comparing msg.sender against db.ballotOwner.
Time-window check using block.timestamp against unpacked ballot start/end times plus deprecated flag.
Mutual-exclusion guarded low-level ETH send with arbitrary calldata to an arbitrary address.
Drains the whole contract balance to the configured payTo address using doSafeSend.
Records sponsorship via library then forwards the received msg.value to the index payTo with doSafeSend.
Deploys a new ballot; derives ballotId from specHash, calls library init and passes msg.sender as ballot owner/admin.
Performs low-level calls with limited gas to an untrusted ERC20 address to test owner()/controller() signatures before claiming democracy ownership.
Basic-tier ballot quota logic; computes msg.value minus fee, refunds excess and pays the index via doSafeSend.
Community ballot deployment; forwards price to payments and refunds the remainder to the caller using doSafeSend.
Accepts ETH payment, credits account time and forwards msg.value to the payTo address via a native transfer.
ERC20 owner claim path; sets democracy owner and editor, gated by only_editors and the claim-disabled flag.
Logs ballot deployment keyed by msg.sender with the current block timestamp.
Admin self-upgrade; only_admin gated, uses msg.sender and refuses the contract owner.
Owner transfer gated by only_owner; writes the owner state variable.
Owner-only arbitrary low-level forward of calldata to the ENS registry contract.
Sets an ENS node address; guarded by the only_owner(node) modifier which queries ens.owner(node) against msg.sender.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as key into per-caller mappings.
Block timestamp (now) used for ballot windows, vote packing, quota windows and account crediting.
Contract owner address used by only_owner / owner_or authorization modifiers.
Boolean reentrancy mutex set before and cleared after the external value call.
Monotonic vote counter and index into the votes mapping.
Per-address replay-protection sequence number for proxy votes.
Per-ballot administrator used by requireBallotOwner.
Timestamp until which a democracy account is paid up.
Array of registered BBFarm interfaces upgraded and indexed by SVIndex.
Low-level call transferring ETH with arbitrary data to an arbitrary address (toAddr.call.value(amount)(data)).
Unchecked scalar increment db.nVotesCast += 1 performed after storage writes in _addVote.
Gas-limited low-level call to an attacker-controlled erc20 address probing OWNER_SIG / CONTROLLER_SIG selectors.
Native transfer of msg.value to the configured payTo address after state updates.
Owner-controlled forwarding of arbitrary calldata via address(ens).call(data).
msg.value based subtraction computing refund remainder (msg.value - fee) in the quota path.
ballotId parameter of BBFarm.sponsor selecting the target ballot DB.
voteData parameter of BBLib.submitVote stored into the votes mapping.
proxyReq signature array parameter of BBLib.submitProxyVote supplying r/s/v, ballotId and voteData.
voter local holding the ecrecover result used as the vote sender.
democHash parameter of SVIndexBackend.setDOwnerFromClaim selecting the democracy record.
newOwner parameter of owned.setOwner assigned to the owner state variable.
amount parameter of safeSend.doSafeSendWData forwarded as the ETH value of the external call.

edges.reason: BBLib.init reads block.timestamp to require endTs > now and to clamp startTs = max(startTs, now).
_addVote invokes requireBallotOpen before recording the vote.
requireBallotOpen validates the current block timestamp against the ballot's unpacked start and end times.
_addVote performs the unchecked counter increment after writing vote storage.
The nVotesCast state variable is the operand of the unchecked increment.
BBLib.submitVote delegates vote recording to _addVote with msg.sender.
BBLib.submitVote keys replay protection on msg.sender by setting sequenceNumber[msg.sender] = MAX_UINT32.
Direct-vote path writes the sequenceNumber mapping for the caller, disabling future proxy votes for that address.
BBLib.submitProxyVote calls _addVote with the signature-recovered voter address.
proxyReq parameter supplies r, s, v, ballotId, voteData and sequence used to build the signed digest.
The voter local receives the ecrecover result and is later used as the vote sender.
requireBallotOwner asserts msg.sender equals the stored ballot owner.
The ballotOwner state variable is the authorization source for ballot admin actions.
doSafeSendWData issues the low-level value call guarded only by a boolean mutex.
The external callee's fallback can re-enter the sending contract; the mutex is cleared only after the call returns.
txMutex3847834 is set before and reset after the external call to block reentry.
payoutAll forwards the full contract balance through doSafeSend to a configurable payTo address.
BBFarm.sponsor forwards msg.value to db.index.getPayTo() using doSafeSend.
sponsor reaches an external value-bearing call to an index-controlled destination.
The quota path sends the extra ballot fee and refunds the remainder using doSafeSend.
The quota path computes the refund remainder by subtracting the fee from msg.value.
dDeployCommunityBallot sends the price to payments and refunds the caller with doSafeSend.
payForDemocracy transfers msg.value to payTo after updating account state.
dOwnerErc20Claim performs low-level gas-limited calls into an untrusted ERC20 address.
fwdToENS forwards arbitrary calldata to the ENS registry via a low-level call.
setOwner is protected by only_owner which compares msg.sender to the stored owner.
setOwner writes the owner state variable controlling all owner-gated paths.
upgradeMeAdmin is gated by only_admin which resolves permissions for msg.sender.
noteBallotDeployed stores records keyed by msg.sender after checking its upgrade pointer.
noteBallotDeployed records the current block timestamp in the caller's ballot log.
initBallot passes msg.sender as the ballot owner/admin into the library DB.
democHash parameter selects the democracy record that will be assigned a new owner.
PublicResolver.setAddr uses only_owner(node), which requires msg.sender to equal ens.owner(node).
The amount parameter becomes the ETH value attached to the external call.
The ballotId parameter selects which ballot DB the sponsorship is recorded against.
The voteData parameter is written into the votes mapping by _addVote.
The newOwner parameter is assigned to the owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: ballotId is only used to select the target ballot database inside sponsor, so it is abstracted into the sponsor function.
voteData is the payload recorded by the submitVote path and carries no independent semantic behaviour.
proxyReq is the signature payload consumed entirely by the submitProxyVote verification logic.
voter is a transient ecrecover result that only feeds the submitProxyVote flow.
democHash is the lookup key used only by the owner claim routine.
newOwner is the value assigned directly to the owner state variable by setOwner.
amount is the raw ETH value forwarded by the external call inside doSafeSendWData.
